here.label: On here
here.on: On: runs here may use it
here.off: Off: runs here don't use it
here.undecided: Not decided yet: turn it on to let runs here use it

note.ready: Ready here: runs on this computer may use {{name}}.
note.off: Off here: runs on this computer don't use {{name}}.
note.undecided: Not ready here: switch {{name}} on or off for this computer.
note.setPath: Not ready here: set the program path. Runs whose pipeline uses {{name}} don't start on this computer until then.
note.gone: Not ready here: no file at {{path}}. Runs that use {{name}} don't start until it is there again.
note.secret: Not ready here: {{name}} needs a value.
note.unreadable: Not ready here: this computer's keychain can't say whether {{name}} has a value.

bar.addValueHint: Stored in this computer's secret store
bar.turnOnHint: Only on this computer · you confirm it in the window

plain.nothingInstruction: Nothing to fill in on this computer: an instruction is the same everywhere.
plain.nothingSkill: Nothing to fill in on this computer: a skill is the same everywhere.
plain.whenBoth: When an agent starts or resumes

tool.approvalOnce: No · a person approves once per run
tool.approvalEvery: No · a person approves each call
tool.cannotFill: Can't be filled in here yet
tool.nothingHere: Nothing to fill in on this computer: this tool runs as the team defined it.

note.byId: This tool names its secret by id; it can't be filled in here yet. Ask a team admin to publish {{name}} again.

draft.saved: Draft on {{version}} · saved {{time}} · only on this computer
draft.changes: {{fields}} changed · publishing makes {{next}} for the whole team; On this computer is never sent
draft.nothing: Nothing changed yet · publishing makes {{next}} for the whole team; On this computer is never sent

rejected.title: The team's server refused {{version}}
rejected.body: {{reason}} Your draft is kept; fix the reason, then publish again.

rejectedHere.title: Not sent: this computer found the team can't take {{version}}

notAdmin.title: The team's server refused: you are no longer an admin
notAdmin.body: Your draft of {{name}} stays on this computer; only an Admin can publish it. Ask an Admin: {{admins}}.

notAdminHere.title: You are no longer an admin of the team

waiting.title: Waiting to send · retries when the server is back
waiting.body: The server has not answered. Your draft will be published as {{next}} when it does; until the server accepts it, nobody else's runs use it and {{current}} stays the team's.

waitingCreated.body: The server has not answered. {{name}} stays here as waiting to send and is created for the team when it does; until then nobody else's runs use it. Cancel sending takes it back as if it was never created.

bar.refused: Refused {{time}} · fix the reason, then publish again
bar.refusedSame: Refused {{time}} · same as the team's version: publishing would only revert {{version}}
bar.nothingPublished: Nothing is published until the server accepts it

edit.fromTeamEditing: · editing · publishing sends it to every computer
edit.fromTeamWaiting: · your draft on {{version}} · locked while it waits to send
edit.fromTeamWaitingCreated: · waiting to be created · locked while it waits to send

newer.line: {{who}} published {{version}} at {{time}} · your draft is based on {{base}}
newer.lineUnknown: {{version}} was published · your draft is based on {{base}}

conflict.title: The team's server refused: {{version}} was published while you edited
conflict.body: Compare field by field. Rebase keeps the fields only you changed, takes {{who}}'s for the rest, and asks where you both changed the same field. Your draft is kept until you choose.

bar.gives: Rebase gives a draft on {{version}} to publish
bar.pick: Pick Mine or Theirs for {{fields}} to rebase

discard.title: Discard your draft of {{name}}?
discard.body: Your changes to {{fields}} are lost on this computer. {{version}} stays as {{who}} published it.
discard.bodyPlain: Your draft is lost on this computer. {{version}} stays as {{who}} published it.

archived.title: The team's server refused: {{name}} was archived at {{time}}
archived.body: Archived resources can't get new versions, and runs that pinned it were stopped. Your draft on {{version}} is kept on this computer; restore {{name}} to publish it.
archived.fromTeam: · your draft on {{version}} · read-only while archived
archived.discard: Your draft of {{name}} is lost on this computer. The team's {{name}} stays archived.

bar.hint: Restore brings back {{version}} for everyone · admins only

restore.title: Restore {{name}}?
restore.body: {{name}} comes back for everyone on the team; the runs that were stopped stay stopped. Your draft on {{draft}} stays on this computer; publish it once {{name}} is back.
